App

run_app()
Run the Eurostat Indicators Explorer

Data

The catalogue of indicators and countries, downloading an indicator from Eurostat for the countries or the regions, and checking the catalogue against Eurostat

The indicators of the app
countries()
The countries of the app
get_indicator()
Get an indicator for the countries
get_regional()

check_indicators()

Plot

The plotly charts of the tabs: country comparison, ranked bars, maps of the countries and of the regions, scatter plot

plot_country_comp()
Line chart of an indicator for several countries
plot_bar()
Ranked bars of an indicator, animated by year
plot_map()
Map of the countries, animated by year
plot_regions()
Map of the regions, animated by year
plot_scatter()
Scatter plot of two indicators, animated by year
